quarterly_data.quarter: Volex press release: Acquisition of remaining stake in Kepler SignalTek (07-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Volex acquired the remaining 64.3% of Kepler SignalTek Ltd (KST), taking its ownership to 100% (it held 35.7% and had been an investor since KST's formation in 2017), with signing and completion on the release date. KST makes patient-connected medical products (single-use and reusable cables and devices for patient monitoring, surgical procedures, cardiac therapy and ultrasound imaging) in Dongguan, China and Batam, Indonesia, and grew revenue organically by 10% to $51.8 million in the year ended 31 March 2026 (FY2025: $47.0 million); previously equity-accounted as an associate, it is consolidated as a subsidiary within the Medical business from completion. Volex expects it to be immediately earnings enhancing, with return on capital employed above 15% within two years; CEO Nat Rothschild: it supports the medium-term plan to grow to $2 billion of revenue at a 12% underlying operating margin.
quarterly_data.figure: ownership from 35.7% to 100%; KST revenue $51.8 million
